Hymn 21: Come, Listen to a Prophet's Voice
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes

This is hymn number 21 titled "Come, Listen to a Prophet's Voice" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Joseph S. Murdock.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
